runtime_imports_note: the face imports the v4 / TM-K3 rows BY NAME when a kit routed them (the module object the kit runs today), else the core copies (opt_core.kernels.fpf_trimul_v4 / fpf_trimul); tx_sm90a / ef2 / esm_v5 are sub-packages imported at call time; torch only inside functions of the face (the carried sub-packages import torch, triton and -- ef2 -- the ESM-family image's transformers kernels at their own module level; esm_v5/route.py is standard library at import and imports torch / the carried Triton module inside its functions) esm_v61 imports torch, triton and its driver binding (cudrv: cuda.bindings or ctypes/libcuda) at install time only; the package face and its two source modules are loaded by path under fixed module names (the package registers ef2_trimul_v5 / ef2_trimul_v6; a module of either name imported from elsewhere is refused by name, never served). Row of3_form (of3_form.py) imports the LayerNorm provider (opt_core.kernels.ln, row exactln) at call time and nothing else but torch. Row af3t_form (af3t_form.py) imports torch and triton at call time and no other package of this tree.
served_note: tx_sm90a = package 1.2 (prebuilt torch213_cu130_sm90 only; other ABIs refuse by name: no_prebuilt:<tag>); ef2 rows need the ESM-family image (transformers.models.esmfold2 kernels; cuequivariance_ops_torch for the tile row); esm_v5_fwd = the engine's forward line carried whole (torch + triton >= 3.6 with tensor descriptors; no model package of that image), forward only, residual optional; TRIMUL_CELLS.json trimul_cells/v1: 178 measured cells on 7 stacks (cc 9.0 and 8.0), 48 target-coverage rows esm_v61 = the sealed package generation 6.1 (K3 = prebuilt sm_90a cubins through the CUDA driver: capability 9.0, c 256 bf16, forward only, residual True or the zero-tile form; keyed by architecture, one payload for every image whose driver loads it; refusals by name -> esm_v5_fwd / v4). esm_v5_fwd:f32in = row esm_v5_fwd's line behind a boundary cast for fp32 / tf32 callers (z -> bf16 once, update -> fp32; tolerance class vs the fp32 stock op; never chosen by a tier word). native / native_exact / native:f32in = the sealed package trimul_native under kernels/trimul/native/pkg/<ACTIVE_PKG> (ACTIVE_PKG v5 = 1.2.2 since 0.5.108.0 -- 1.2.0's kernels byte for byte with a bounded workspace-retention policy on both members; v4 = 1.2.1 from 0.5.105.0, v3 = 1.2.0 from 0.5.96.0 --: sm_90a + sm_80 members, see TRIMUL_CELLS.json rows.native.payload; the sm_90a envelope as recorded for 1.1.0: 24 sm_90a cubins launched through the CUDA driver: capability 9.0, every (c_z, c_hidden) pair of {64,128,256,384}^2 for bf16 z (fast + exact variants), fp32 z inside a bf16 autocast region at the nine pairs without a 384 width (fp32 update / residual sum; fp32-resident z with a 384 width refused by name no_cubin:sm_90a:z<c_z>_h<c_hidden>_f32z), forward only, residual optional; one payload for every image whose driver loads it; digests + load check + the payload's vectors as byte gate once per process; native_exact = bitwise == the cuequivariance op where the cells' vouched_on records the stack, refused by name below 101 tokens (exact_small_n); cc != 9.0 refused by name (cc_unsupported: no sm_80 member in 1.1.0); refusals by name -> v4 / tmk3_exact / cueq; pkg/v1 (1.0.1) inert on disk for one version).
carried_digests_note: sha256 of every kit-origin file of the four donor-backed sub-packages as carried (core_added files and the two package markers excluded; the not_byte_identical files: of the restated bytes).  The kit byte-identity test pins the carried copy to these and compares a kit copy found beside common/ digest to digest: equal passes; a kit copy that is absent, moved or edited after the carry is a SKIP BY NAME naming the file and both digests -- the provider serves the carried bytes until the release lead names the kit's newer bytes the source of record (then re-carry = copy + record).
